Title: Set a new slot for a shop with start time exactly at midnight (boundary: minimum time value)
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop admin. Shop with ID 1 exists and has no existing slots of type 'REGULAR'.

1. Navigate to the 'Manage Slots' section for Shop ID 1. 2. Select slot type 'REGULAR'. 3. Set start time to '00:00'. 4. Set end time to '01:00'. 5. Click 'Save Slot'.

Test Data: shopId = 1, slotType = REGULAR, startTime = 00:00, endTime = 01:00
